cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Prove Your Loyalty
cards.instruction: Invent small tests of loyalty and judge every response without admitting there is a test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Could you keep Friday free? I might need help moving.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've promised to help Alex paint.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Right. Paint takes priority. Could you at least leave your phone on?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. Have you actually found a flat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Still looking. Nice that I'm worth a charged battery. This is just planning.

mechanism: A miscopies class etiquette confidently while converting B's partner choices into deniable loyalty tests.
confusable: D10 openly seeks selection; D11 evaluates every answer while pretending each demand has another purpose.
comparison: Class partner rotation and private walk differ from professional scheduling.
seedUse: D11-b turns a helpful compromise into a smaller judged test.
